claims.content: Save the current game state to a file.

goal.raw_text: Save the current game state to a file.

claims.content: A game session is currently active and loaded.
The application's menu bar is accessible to the player.
The player selects the 'Save Game' option from the menu bar.

trigger.raw_text: The player selects the 'Save Game' option from the menu bar.

claims.content: The system displays a dialog box allowing the user to choose a file that will contain all the data of the current game.

The system saves the following internal data into the selected file: the current positions of the blocks, their previous positions (up to the last 10000), the number of previous movements, and the time passed by the user to solve the headache.
If the game has never been saved before, the system processes the 'Save Game As...' action instead, prompting the user to choose a new file location.
The current game state has been successfully written to a file.
The saved file contains the current positions of all blocks.
The saved file contains the previous positions of the blocks (up to the last 10,000 moves).
The saved file contains the total number of movements made by the player.
The saved file contains the total time elapsed since the start of the game session.
